description: Searches the US trade.gov Consolidated Screening List (Entity List, SDN, Denied Persons, Unverified, ITAR Debarred, etc.) by name and optional country. Each hit includes list name, aliases, addresses, programs, federal register notice, and match score. Price: $0.003 in USDC per successful call, paid with x402 (Base, Solana or Arc); failed calls are not charged.

country.description: Optional ISO-2 country code filter (e.g. RU, CN, IR)

name.description: Name or keyword to search (1–200 characters)
